sections._why: the hook: the rush of the airliner, the engine dying, no music
three in the afternoon, Gus and his movie; stops as the engines do
it all goes quiet: the engine winds down, the screen clicks off
the neighbor grabs his seat, Gus yells (downbeat), the rock, the sandwich
'But wait': dead stop with the record_stop; thin air underneath
the explanation: wings lift, engines push
coasting down the hill on the bike
a hill made of air, one to fifteen, the ramp
over a hundred miles, almost twenty minutes
the night glide over the Atlantic
here's the thing: idle a hundred miles out
gliding home; button after the last word
